thread:
Miguel Santos: Heads up team — planning a staged CRM hygiene write-run tomorrow 02:00 PT. Targets: dedupe merges, archive stale contacts, apply healthscore_v5.
Aisha Khan: Which playbook and are we including the renewal_risk flag changes? Need to notify SalesOps.
Miguel Santos: playbook: cs_auto_v5. Renewal flag: yes, threshold lowered to 0.45 for proactive outreach. Notifying SalesOps in a sec.
Priya Patel: We changed the usage-window to 90d in v5, correct? That was causing some edge shifts last week.
Miguel Santos: Correct — usage window = 90 days. decay=0.8. Also bumped NPS weight +12%.
Grace Liu: Important: exclude accounts tagged `enablement:pilot` and `beta_onboard` from merges. Don't want to break pilot telemetry.
Miguel Santos: Exclusion added. Query uses `AND NOT (tags && ARRAY['enablement:pilot','beta_onboard'])`.
Aisha Khan: Can we gate high churn-prob with manual review? Last time automation sniped an account flagged incorrectly.
Miguel Santos: Canary plan: first 150 high-risk (p>=0.6) -> manual queue. After that, automated playbook triggers.
opsbot: write-run scheduled by Miguel Santos at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z - job id wr-3940001111-02. Mode: staged. Status: scheduled.
Priya Patel: Miguel — Ops wants expected cardinality deltas for migration window. Can you share pre-run counts?
Miguel Santos: Dry-run summary pasted: duplicates flagged: 6,123; stale contacts to archive: 1,804; accounts with score delta >=15: 870. Export CSV linked: https://internal.redwood/cs/exports/wr-3940001111-dryrun.csv
Grace Liu: For feedback capture: after reset we should trigger the one-week enablement survey only for accounts with score increase >10 and onboarding_status = completed. Can we wire webhook to surveys-service?
Aisha Khan: Yes — I added a post-processing hook in playbook config. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood/surveys/cs_enablement
Priya Patel: Rollback plan? If >1% of accounts get unexpected churn label, we stop and revert to snapshot. Who runs revert?
Miguel Santos: Revert steps in PR: snapshot daily before write -> DB restore script `cs.rollback_to_snapshot(snapshot_id)` + reindex scores. Infra lead runs restore; CS ops monitors.
Aisha Khan: I'll create a short runbook snippet and paste logs to the channel during job. Also adding a tag `hygiene:run-3940001111` so we can query post-run.
Grace Liu: Can we also send a short heads-up to customer enablement Slack channel once the write is done? They need to queue personalized outreach for newly flagged renewal_risks.
Miguel Santos: Will do. Slack ping configured in playbook post-run hook.
Priya Patel: One more ask — include a metric delta for `active_users` and `avg_weekly_sessions` in the CSV so PMs can validate product usage impact.
Miguel Santos: Added to export columns.
opsbot: write-run wr-3940001111-02: pre-checks passed. Canary queue initialized. Next update: job start.
